name: Noob Tower Defense ☄️
desc:
Welcome to Noob Tower Defense! ☄️

⭐ The noobs are coming. Build your towers, hold the line, and stop the endless waves of blocky invaders before they overrun your base!

⚔️ Roll for rare towers and expand your arsenal with unique summons!
✨ Power up your favourites with enchantments to crush tougher waves and climb further than ever.
🏆 Prove you're the best noob-slayer around and rise to the top of the global rankings!

👍 New code every 1000 likes!
🎉 New Updates EVERY Saturday!

📱💻 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console – grab your squad and crush the noob invasion together!
🔥 Like and join the community for an exclusive daily spin, rare rewards and 2x game speed!

🔗 Tags: Noob, Tower Defense, TD, Strategy, Survival, Defense
